# Larkspur

A fictional seasonal restaurant concept ("Larkspur", Cold Spring, NY) built as a
design and engineering portfolio piece by Fo on behalf of Stephen Fehon.
Every page is static HTML with hand-written CSS and vanilla JavaScript, no
frameworks, no external dependencies.

## Site map

- /            Home: hero, press marquee, philosophy, menu preview, room gallery, journal, reservation CTA
- /menu        Full menus: tasting, à la carte, wine, cocktails, zero-proof, with filters
- /story       Chef story, season timeline, farm partners, press
- /journal     Journal index with four essays
- /journal/reading-a-menu.html        Essay: Reading a Menu Is Reading a Place
- /journal/the-long-table.html        Essay: The Case for the Three-Hour Dinner
- /journal/season-as-constraint.html  Essay: Season Is Not a Limitation, It Is the Idea
- /reserve     Reservations, hours, private dining, accessibility, FAQ
- /404.html    Designed not-found page

## Notes

- Restaurant, people, menu and press quotes are invented for the portfolio.
- Fonts: Fraunces (display) and Inter (text), self-hosted, loaded via font-display swap.
- Theme: light "paper" default, dark "late service" theme, toggle persisted in localStorage.
- Accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA targets, prefers-reduced-motion honored, keyboard-complete.
